column1: # Why measures: TRAN 0.1N 47.9N with no tmax steps the LTRA ladder at
# ~1 ns, and the pointwise gate trips on three v(10) samples 27 mV apart
# during a 5 V edge. The reference's v(11) crosstalk peak is the least
# stable quantity in the family: ngspice-47 reads 0.889 V, ngspice-46
# 0.965 V at the same step and 1.016 V refined 5x, so no gate tighter
# than that 15 percent spread would be honest there. Everything else is
# grid-stable: crossings move under refinement by at most 8 ps and RSpice
# sits within 6 ps; the settled means move by 0.1 mV or less.
# Sources: vdd/v3 PULSE rails rising at t=0, VS1/VS2 PULSE 0->5 V at
# 15.9 ns and 5->0 V at 31.7 ns. The rails' turn-on puts a first
# crossing near 1 ns on v(6), v(8), v(12), so their signal edges are the
# first fall and the second rise; v(9) crosses only on the signal.
# v(7), v(11) are the coupled-line crosstalk nodes.
